India's Q1 FY27 GDP Growth Reaches 7.8%, Data Debate Emerges

India's real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by 7.8% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. This growth is supported by a range of high-frequency indicators, suggesting a strong and widespread economic expansion. A debate arose concerning the GDP figures due to erroneous comparisons between older and updated data sets, which led to misleading claims of a 2.6% nominal growth. The newer metrics incorporate refined data collection techniques.
